mapper.insert: insert into marketing_promotion_refund_fact (order_type, order_id, refund_registration_id, refund_application_id, out_refund_no, refunded_fen, total_fen, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{orderType}, #{orderId}, #{refundRegistrationId}, #{refundApplicationId}, #{outRefundNo}, #{refundedFen}, #{totalFen}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createTime}) on duplicate key update id = id
mapper.select: select a.order_id from marketing_order_adjustment a join cms_registration refunded on refunded.id = #{registrationId} join cms_registration promo_order on promo_order.id = a.order_id where a.order_type = #{orderType} and a.member_id = refunded.member_id and ( a.order_id = refunded.id or (refunded.parent_order_no is not null and refunded.parent_order_no <> '' and promo_order.parent_order_no = refunded.parent_order_no) ) order by (a.order_id = refunded.id) desc, a.order_id asc
